meta.name: DocPilot Phase 4 benchmark — classic-vs-agentic comparison
meta.note: The same question set runs through both pipelines (Phase 1 direct fast path vs Phase 2 agentic loop with Phase 3 GitHub tool). docs-answerable rows carry gold key facts as short paraphrase-robust fragments (an identifier or concept every correct answer must contain — verbatim corpus sentences over-penalize normal paraphrasing) + gold source files (stored corpus paths, as returned by the vector store) for retrieval recall and citation scoring; live-state rows expect the tool to fire and a cited live answer; neither rows expect the verbatim 'I don't know' refusal. Expanded 2026-09-10 to 30 rows for the pre-Phase-6 hardening benchmark (PLAN §H): +12 docs-answerable (exact-identifier / keyword rows bd09–bd15, bd17–bd20 + cross-chapter multi-hop stressor bd16) and +3 neither (adversarial refusals bn04–bn06).
